title: U.S. Commercial Fisheries Landings Trend Analysis
description: Built an end-to-end PostgreSQL pipeline ingesting 159K+ commercial landing records (1950–2024) from the NOAA FOSS REST API. Designed the analytical layer in SQL using window functions, CTE chains, and Postgres regression aggregates to surface multi-decade decline signals and rank state revenue exposure to declining stocks.

title: Bikewatching
description: Built an interactive Mapbox GL JS visualization of Boston bike traffic data, showing station activity, trip flows, and ridership patterns across the city's Bluebikes network.

title: HydraMate – Smart Hydration Coaster
description: Led a 12-person team to build a smart water coaster that tracks fluid intake via a load cell and HX711 amplifier, architecting the full data pipeline across an ESP32 microcontroller, Firebase, and a React Native app. Implemented ESP32 Bluetooth pairing with Firebase real-time sync for live hydration status updates.

title: Comeback Prediction in Professional Esports (League of Legends)
description: Built a Random Forest classification model to predict win-from-deficit outcomes using 150K+ professional esports match records. Engineered features capturing resource/experience gaps and objective control; improved F1-score by 347% over baseline through feature engineering and model selection.

title: STEM Degree Distribution & Socioeconomic Analysis
description: Analyzed College Scorecard dataset (6,000+ institutions) to investigate the relationship between low-income student enrollment and STEM degree share at U.S. public colleges. Found a statistically significant negative relationship (r = -0.107, p = 0.009).

title: CAT 3 Survival Guide Website
description: Led a 4-person team to design and launch a project website delivering a UCSD CAT 3 course survival guide. Presented to 30 students and 2 professors, handling project coordination, design decisions, and final pitch.
